event_summary: A black kettlebell descends onto a white cup on a wooden tabletop and the cup becomes flattened beneath it.
raw_event_description: At the start, a white tapered cup lies on its side on a wooden tabletop near the center of the frame, with a black object partly visible along the top edge. The black object moves downward and becomes identifiable as a kettlebell with an arched handle and a teal '30 LB' marking. It continues downward toward the cup, contacts the upper side of the cup, and the cup visibly changes shape from a tilted hollow cylinder into a compressed, flattened form under the kettlebell. Afterward the kettlebell remains nearly still, upright over the crushed cup, with a black vertical band extending upward from its handle out of the frame.

reasons: The white cup and tabletop are clearly visible before contact.
Only the lower portion of the black descending object is visible at the top edge in the first frame.
No contact between the black object and the cup is visible in the first frame.
